title: Decline of the Mauryan Empire
quote: No single theory accepted; historians stress structural weakness and weak successors over religious reaction

boxes.title: Theories of decline
head: Theory
Historian
Core argument
rows: Pro-Buddhist policy, ban on sacrifices angered Brahmins
Depended on king; weak successors → collapse

boxes.title: Evidence & counter-points
items: Finance: **Dhamma mission** + Sangha donations; ==**debased later punch-marked coins**==
Taxes even on actors and prostitutes (**Arthashastra**)
Weak, oppressive successors after Ashoka's death (**232 BC**)
Against Brahmanical reaction: Pushyamitra was a Mauryan general; Buddhist art thrived under Sungas

boxes.title: End of the dynasty
steps: Senani ==**Pushyamitra Sunga**== kills him at a **military review**
